name: Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz - § 37 - Am 24
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 37. Notes the fact that the new market access commitments with regard to trade in services could open up new business opportunities for EU and Mexican companies in strategic sectors, such as telecommunications and transport; welcomes the provisions ensuring non-discriminatory treatment and equal opportunities for EU and Mexican service providers in both markets; notes that the Agreement contains a state-of-the-art chapter on digital trade; expresses concern that some provisions, including restrictions on access to source code, may limit the transparency and accountability of algorithmic systems and undermine labour rights, including for platform workers; calls on the Commission to ensure that digital trade provisions do not undermine the EU’s digital regulatory framework, including transparency and consumer protection objectives;
